headline: Alector Surpasses Consensus Estimates with Earnings and Revenue Beat
summary: Alector posted an earnings beat by $1.32 and reported revenue that topped analyst estimates.
why: Biotech earnings beats can significantly impact stock valuations by validating clinical or commercial progress.

impacts.name: Alector
impacts.why: Beating both earnings and revenue estimates positively impacts investor sentiment for the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected financial results relative to consensus forecasts directly drive positive valuation adjustments.
